description: Use this when the user wants to build, create, compose or formulate a perfume, fragrance or accord and needs a starting recipe (a rose, a citrus cologne, a clean musk, an amber), or asks what they could make with materials they list. Matches the idea to PerfuMate's reference accords, the vetted recipes published at perfumate.app/accords, and returns the closest match with its percentages and grams for a batch, already checked against IFRA Category 4 at the concentration given (verdict, highest safe concentration, allergens to declare), plus a link that opens it in PerfuMate and a few alternatives. The ratios are the library's own; nothing is invented, and an idea no accord fits returns the list of available accords instead. Re-check any edited version with check_formula. Not for copying a named commercial perfume. Does not save anything.

batchGrams.description: Batch size in grams for the amounts.

concentrationPct.description: How much of the finished product these lines would be, for the IFRA check, e.g. 20 for an eau de parfum.

haveMaterials.description: Materials the user already has; accords they can make with them rank first and the missing ones are listed.

idea.description: What the user wants to make, in their words, e.g. "fresh citrus cologne", "rose", "clean laundry musk".
